facts.fact: The FY2017 (2024/25) fourth-quarter budget-versus-expenditure report, produced from IFMIS/IBEX for period Sene-2017, gives the Ministry of Innovation and Technology's year-end outturn of ETB 989,820,128 against ETB 2,754,552,330 voted, per the Ministry of Finance data; the enacted budget was loaded to IFMIS.
